investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell script executed on DC-EAST-01 under SYSTEM account. The embedded script block collects Active Directory domain/password policy details and appears consistent with automated administrative checks rather than a direct payload. A prior similar alert (SOC-2105) exists on the same endpoint with identical script content, which was closed as a false positive by the client as part of a daily compliance check. Based on this corroborating context and lack of external network indicators, the activity is classified as Low Priority (LP).
